newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX JGB's, Euroyen/dlrs rally as rates seen flat.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX JGB's, Euroyen/dlrs rally as rates seen flat.

text.p: SIMEX Japanese government bond (JGB) and Euroyen futures rallied strongly on Wednesday after the Bank of Japan's (BOJ) tankan report on corporate sentiment dampened recent fears of a rise in Japanese interest rates.
"It is all based on the tankan," said one Singapore dealer with a U.S. bank. "The report suggested sentiment wouldn't allow a rise in rates soon, possibly within this half of the year."
SIMEX JGB futures had a roller-coaster ride, with the June contract opening at 125.53, climbing to a high of 126.91 and then falling back to settle at 126.61.
The close mirrored the Tokyo futures performance, which ended offer-only after aggressive profit-taking pared their earlier rises.
"Personally, I feel the markets could go higher," the Singapore trader said. "Some shops say they don't discount a jump up to 127, which I agree may be possible," he added.
Dealers said Euroyen futures market largely followed the JGBs. The December Euroyen traded around 99.39 at 1130 GMT against its IMM close at 99.00. Volume was just over 4,750 lots.
SIMEX June Eurodollars were much steadier than Euroyen, ending at 94.030, against their IMM close at 94.025.
Dealers said most of the market was waiting for Friday's employment data for March.
